independence_evidence: Published by Der Greif e.V., a registered non-profit association for contemporary photography at Atelierstr. 18, 81671 Munich (address in the site footer and on Der Greif's own Picter terms pages); issues are supported by the Alexander Tutsek-Stiftung foundation and there is no parent media group.
qualifies_reason: Non-profit-published photography annual whose Issue 19 (guest-edited by Zanele Muholi) was released at launch events on 12-14 November 2026, following Issue 18 in November 2025.
what_it_is: Der Greif is an annual print magazine of contemporary photography assembled from an open call: each issue is guest-edited by an established artist, who selects and sequences submitted photographs and texts from image makers around the world into a single themed volume. Recent issues are softcover A5 books of around 100 pages in English, with earlier numbers in a larger classic format. It suits photographers, curators and collectors who follow emerging photographic work and artist-curated publications.

uncertainties: Publication date is taken from the publisher's own launch events (12-14 November 2026 at Paris Photo and Atelier 13, 'to celebrate the release of Der Greif Issue 19', with copies on sale); the product page still carries an older 'pre-order for EUR 16, publishing November 2026' line although the listed price is now EUR 19 and the Shopify feed shows it available. The about and imprint pages return HTTP 404 to plain fetches, so the publisher's legal name and Munich address come from the site-wide footer and from Der Greif's own terms pages hosted on Picter. Frequency follows the cadence of Issues 17 (2024), 18 (Nov 2025) and 19 (Nov 2026). The Issue 19 cover images were not visually checked; one is explicitly a mockup.
